```{r}
library(foreign)
library(e1071)
library(mclust)
library(BayesCVI)
library(UniversalCVI)
library(dbscan)
```

```{r include=FALSE}
dat1 <- read.arff("data_set_1.arff")

# Pair plot
pairs(dat1, col = dat1$class, main = "Pair Plot: True Class Labels")

# ---------------- K-Means ----------------
dat1_km_cvi <- Hvalid(scale(dat1[,1:2]), 10, indexlist = "all", method = "kmeans")
plot_idx(dat1_km_cvi)

dat1_km <- kmeans(scale(dat1[,1:2]), centers = 10)

par(mfrow = c(1,2))
plot(dat1[,1:2], col = dat1$class, main = "True Class Labels")
plot(dat1[,1:2], col = dat1_km$cluster, main = "K-Means Clustering (k = 10)")
table(dat1_km$cluster - 1, dat1$class)

# ---------------- Hierarchical ----------------
dat1_com <- hclust(dist(scale(dat1[,1:2])), method = "complete")
dat1_avg <- hclust(dist(scale(dat1[,1:2])), method = "single")
dat1_sin <- hclust(dist(scale(dat1[,1:2])), method = "average")

par(mfrow = c(1,3))
plot(dat1[,1:2], col = cutree(dat1_com, 3), main = "Hierarchical: Complete Linkage (k = 3)")
plot(dat1[,1:2], col = cutree(dat1_avg, 3), main = "Hierarchical: Single Linkage (k = 3)")
plot(dat1[,1:2], col = cutree(dat1_sin, 3), main = "Hierarchical: Average Linkage (k = 3)")

# ---------------- Fuzzy C-Means ----------------
dat1_fz_cvi <- FzzyCVIs(dat1[,1:2], 10, indexlist = c('WP', 'PBM'), method = 'FCM', )
plot_idx(dat1_fz_cvi)

dat1_fz <- cmeans(scale(dat1[,1:2]), centers = 10)

par(mfrow = c(1,2))
plot(dat1[,1:2], col = dat1$class, main = "True Class Labels")
plot(dat1[,1:2], col = dat1_fz$cluster, main = "Fuzzy C-Means Clustering (k = 10)")
table(dat1_fz$cluster - 1, dat1$class)

# ---------------- DBSCAN ----------------
kNNdistplot(scale(dat1[,1:2]), k = 4)
eps <- 0.3
minpts <- 100
dat1_dbc <- dbscan(scale(dat1[,1:2]), eps = eps, minPts = minpts)

plot(dat1[,1:2], col = dat1_dbc$cluster + 1, main = "DBSCAN Clustering")

# ---------------- EM (Gaussian Mixture Model) ----------------
dat1_EM <- Mclust(dat1[,1:2])

par(mfrow = c(1,2))
plot(dat1[,1:2], col = dat1$class, main = "True Class Labels")
plot(dat1[,1:2], col = dat1_EM$classification, main = "EM Clustering (GMM)")

# ---------------- Accuracy Comparison ----------------
acc <- AccClust(dat1, label = "class", algorithm = c("FCM", "EM", "Kmeans"), nstart = 20, fzm = 10)

acc
```

### data 1 (10 class)  

### cluster บังคับเลือก 10 กลุ่ม 

ได้ผลว่า EM สามารถแบ่งกลุ่มข้อมูลได้ดีที่สุด ด้วย Accuracy = 54.7%

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1,3))


# True labels
plot(dat1[,1:2], col = dat1$class, main = "True Class Labels")

# DBSCAN
plot(dat1[,1:2], col = dat1_dbc$cluster + 1, main = "DBSCAN Clustering")

# EM (GMM)
plot(dat1[,1:2], col = dat1_EM$classification, main = "EM Clustering (GMM)")

# K-Means
plot(dat1[,1:2], col = dat1_km$cluster, main = "K-Means Clustering (k = 10)")

# Hierarchical: Complete Linkage
plot(dat1[,1:2], col = cutree(dat1_com, 3), main = "Hierarchical: Complete Linkage (k = 3)")

# Hierarchical: Single Linkage
plot(dat1[,1:2], col = cutree(dat1_avg, 3), main = "Hierarchical: Single Linkage (k = 3)")

# Hierarchical: Average Linkage
plot(dat1[,1:2], col = cutree(dat1_sin, 3), main = "Hierarchical: Average Linkage (k = 3)")

# Fuzzy C-Means
plot(dat1[,1:2], col = dat1_fz$cluster, main = "Fuzzy C-Means Clustering (k = 10)")
```

```{r include=FALSE}
dat2 <- read.arff("data_set_2.arff")

# Pair plot
pairs(dat2, col = dat2$CLASS, main = "Pair Plot: True Class Labels")

# ---------------- K-Means ----------------
dat2_km_cvi <- Hvalid(scale(dat2[,1:2]), 10, indexlist = "all", method = "kmeans")
plot_idx(dat2_km_cvi)

dat2_km <- kmeans(scale(dat2[,1:2]), centers = 4)

par(mfrow = c(1,2))
plot(dat2[,1:2], col = dat2$CLASS, main = "True Class Labels")
plot(dat2[,1:2], col = dat2_km$cluster, main = "K-Means Clustering (k = 4)")
table(dat2_km$cluster, dat2$CLASS)

# ---------------- Hierarchical ----------------
dat2_com <- hclust(dist(scale(dat2[,1:2])), method = "complete")
dat2_avg <- hclust(dist(scale(dat2[,1:2])), method = "single")
dat2_sin <- hclust(dist(scale(dat2[,1:2])), method = "average")

par(mfrow = c(1,3))
plot(dat2[,1:2], col = cutree(dat2_com, 2), main = "Hierarchical: Complete Linkage (k = 2)")
plot(dat2[,1:2], col = cutree(dat2_avg, 2), main = "Hierarchical: Single Linkage (k = 2)")
plot(dat2[,1:2], col = cutree(dat2_sin, 2), main = "Hierarchical: Average Linkage (k = 2)")

# ---------------- Fuzzy C-Means ----------------
dat2_fz_cvi <- FzzyCVIs(dat2[,1:2], 10, indexlist = c("WP", "PBM"), method = "FCM")
plot_idx(dat2_fz_cvi)

dat2_fz <- cmeans(scale(dat2[,1:2]), centers = 4)

par(mfrow = c(1,2))
plot(dat2[,1:2], col = dat2$CLASS, main = "True Class Labels")
plot(dat2[,1:2], col = dat2_fz$cluster, main = "Fuzzy C-Means Clustering (k = 4)")
table(dat2_fz$cluster, dat2$CLASS)

# ---------------- DBSCAN ----------------
kNNdistplot(scale(dat2[,1:2]), k = 4)
eps <- 0.07
minpts <- 4
dat2_dbc <- dbscan(scale(dat2[,1:2]), eps = eps, minPts = minpts)

par(mfrow = c(1,2))
plot(dat2[,1:2], col = dat2$CLASS, main = "True Class Labels")
plot(dat2[,1:2], col = dat2_dbc$cluster + 1, main = "DBSCAN Clustering")
table(dat2_dbc$cluster, dat2$CLASS)

# ---------------- EM (Gaussian Mixture Model) ----------------
dat2_EM <- Mclust(dat2[,1:2])

par(mfrow = c(1,2))
plot(dat2[,1:2], col = dat2$CLASS, main = "True Class Labels")
plot(dat2[,1:2], col = dat2_EM$classification, main = "EM Clustering (GMM)")
table(dat2_EM$classification, dat2$CLASS)

# ---------------- Accuracy Comparison ----------------
dat2_acc <- AccClust(dat2, label = "CLASS", algorithm = c("FCM", "EM", "Kmeans"), nstart = 20, fzm = 4)
print(dat2_acc)
```

### data 2 (4 class + "noise" class)  

### cluster บังคับเลือก 4 กลุ่ม 

ได้ผลว่า DBSCAN และ EM สามารถแยกกลุ่มได้อย่างชัดเจน (100% และ 99.7% ตามลำดับ)

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1,3))

plot(dat2[,1:2], col = dat2$CLASS, main = "True Class Labels")

plot(dat2[,1:2], col = dat2_dbc$cluster + 1, main = "DBSCAN Clustering")

plot(dat2[,1:2], col = dat2_EM$classification, main = "EM Clustering (GMM)")

plot(dat2[,1:2], col = dat2_km$cluster, main = "K-Means Clustering (k = 4)")

plot(dat2[,1:2], col = cutree(dat2_com, 2), main = "Hierarchical: Complete Linkage (k = 2)")
plot(dat2[,1:2], col = cutree(dat2_avg, 2), main = "Hierarchical: Single Linkage (k = 2)")
plot(dat2[,1:2], col = cutree(dat2_sin, 2), main = "Hierarchical: Average Linkage (k = 2)")

plot(dat2[,1:2], col = dat2_fz$cluster, main = "Fuzzy C-Means Clustering (k = 4)")

```
